scope: Standalone immediate window tracker; not the final record or PS command ABI

request.protocol: one-cycle strobe with registered accepted/rejected; ready indicates capacity, not argument validity
request.history: PRE_SAMPLES contiguous qualified previous samples with identical source/calibration/config/FIR context
request.identity: independent 64-bit capture counter, starts at 1 and stops accepting after UINT64_MAX
request.tx_token: opaque 64-bit association; zero permitted for unassociated captures

ownership: Bind exactly one changed bank generation plus capture_id and owner_epoch. Result waits for PENDING or ownership failure. result_ready only releases tracker context, never RAW storage. Consumer must revalidate owner_epoch/generation before acting on a held result.
cancel: Marks active window invalid; waits for finite requested window to stop. Does not free storage.
limits: One outstanding context. Descriptor metadata frozen at acceptance. ADC sample_seq and GSC must describe the same 125 MHz tick. Parameters require 1<=ADDR_W<=14 and 1<=PRE_SAMPLES<=2**ADDR_W-3. No replay pin is produced.
